resources.string: Save a server locally, verify your key, then select a project by its exact ID. Saving never connects or creates a project.
No saved servers. Add a server and personal key to begin.
The key is encrypted using Android Keystore. Input is cleared on save, Back or rotation and is never saved in screen state.
Enter a server name (1–256 characters, no control characters).
Check the HTTPS server URL. URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.
Enter an access key: 1–8192 ASCII characters, without spaces or line breaks.
Showing previously cached data; it may be out of date.
Waiting for sync. No document data is fabricated.
No cached documents for this exact project identity. Connect to download them.
Read-only Markdown from the sync cache. Online editing requires a separate live room and compatibility checks.
Only the explicitly selected project connects. Keys stay native; document cache is app-private and excluded from backup. Reading sends no document writes.
Access key missing or rejected (401/4401). Replace the personal key; automatic retry is stopped.
Incompatible Remote protocol version. Update compatible clients/server before connecting. No writes are sent.
TLS certificate validation failed. Check the server certificate; security checks are not bypassed.
Invalid server or project configuration (4400). Check the exact URL and project ID.
Network unavailable, connection timed out or receive queue full. Cached data remains readable. Check the connection and retry.
Automatic reconnect is pending with backoff. Disconnect to stop it.
Local storage unavailable or damaged. Previous durable data is preserved; do not clear app data to retry.
Some Remote paths differ only by letter case. They are kept separately here, but Windows may treat them as the same file.
Remote returned an invalid response or rejected the request. The session stopped safely; cached data may be stale.
Read-only cache snapshot. This is not a live editor; recent changes may be missing.
In live room only — Remote save not confirmed
Closing — waiting for flush and save confirmation…
Closed with local recovery — Remote save NOT confirmed
Local recovery retained — Remote save NOT confirmed
Document revision changed — waiting for synchronization
Read-only — compatibility write gate is closed
Reconnect required — Remote save not confirmed
Local diagnostic copy, not a confirmed Remote save. Review and copy Markdown manually. Nothing is automatically restored, merged or sent to Remote.
No local recovery entries are available for the selected identity.
No readable Markdown snapshot. Raw diagnostics remain in local storage; they cannot be replayed here.
This Android System WebView lacks the secure editor bridge. Update WebView; the cached document remains read-only.
The editor stopped. Review local recovery before reopening; recent changes may not be saved remotely.
Key accepted — not a synchronized project
Previously verified: %1$s · Account ID: %2$s · Checked at: %3$s. Historical only; verify again before connecting.
Project catalog could not be loaded. Previous rows may be stale.
Known projects on this device — offline or not verified; not a current catalog.
Project catalog not loaded or stale. Refresh before selecting or creating.
No projects on this server. Creation is a separate confirmed action.
Project catalog loaded. Names are labels; exact IDs identify projects.
Server upgrade required — project catalog unavailable. No legacy space connection or creation is attempted.
Select only this exact ID, account and storage epoch. Previous edits are not moved or sent to this project. Selection does not connect.
Connect only this exact identity. Missing projects are never recreated. Cached or recovered edits are not replayed into a new room.
This sends one explicit creation request to this server. It does not select or connect the project. If the result is unknown, check the original ID; never retry automatically.
ID: 1–64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores; start with a letter or digit. IDs are never normalized.
Display names are trimmed and normalized to NFC (1–120 Unicode code points). The exact normalized name and unchanged ID are shown before creation.
Check the exact project ID and display name. Control and bidirectional override characters are not allowed.
Original ID not found — any new attempt requires explicit creation confirmation
Project ID already exists — not claimed as this creation
Check only the original ID. A found project may belong to a concurrent creator; selecting it is a separate confirmation.
Project identity changed. Old edits remain local recovery and will not be sent to the new target.
Project not found. Nothing was recreated. Refresh the catalog and select an existing exact ID.
This project ID already exists. Refresh or look up the original ID; no automatic retry was sent.
Server redirect refused. Check the exact HTTPS URL; the key is never forwarded.
The server request timed out. Creation may have an unknown result; check the original ID.
This action belongs to an older selection. Verify and select again.
Unknown — not inferred from the current selection
Legacy archive — no proven v2 epoch
Local draft — no confirmed Remote save
Room recovery — no replay or overwrite authority
Original identity — read and copy only
Server sequence moved backwards — old pending writes are quarantined
Legacy originals are retained unchanged. Candidate IDs are not active bindings. Acceptance is explicit and does not connect or replay edits.
Unresolved or ambiguous — archive only, no v2 target invented
Candidate identity — exact catalog mapping required before activation
Accept only the original UUID with the same initial storage epoch and account. Originals stay intact; old pending writes remain recovery and never become a replay queue. This does not connect.
Legacy records — original selectors, not selected v2 projects
Legacy data must be archived and its exact mapping accepted before selecting this project. No old files are deleted or replayed.
Archived cached Markdown — not current server state
Archived pending snapshot — outcome unconfirmed, no replay
Raw diagnostic items: %1$d — no decoding or replay
